profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Sophos
profile.summary: I am always striving to learn and expand my horizons.  I champion a quality mindset, believe in agile software development, and consider success or failure in terms of the entire team.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Supporting the integration of AI into our product with new and dynamic ways to query and investigate cybersecurity events.

positions.title: Senior Manager Software Development
positions.description: Led a team of 15-18 Software Testers across several product lines to coordinate testing effort.  We helped to vastly improve a startup mentality toward a more mature and structured sdlc.  Hired and cultivated a team for over three years that stayed together and established a dynamic atmosphere of group ownership.

positions.title: QA Manager
positions.description: I was at first the sole hire to head QA efforts on the MDR product.  Built the entire QA team and qa system up to 10-12 engineers, and we helped to build the most successful product line in the company.

positions.title: Principal Test Engineer
positions.description:
Job eliminated due to COVID-19

A very brief stint as Principle QA Engineer in which I mentored several QA engineers across several different product lines.  The big thing here was establishing QA engineers as a serious disciplien, with quidelines and documentation to Inititative Days where we developed tools and projects of our very own.

positions.title: Principal QA Engineer
positions.description: I was assigned to help with the RedOwl cybersecurity suite that had been acquired.  At the time, the sales team had to test installations.  I immediately made that a QA focus...the installation and reinstallations had to be covered.  This greatlhy improved customer experience in the long run and actually exposed issues and solved problems that crossed over into general use.  It also changed how we looked at QA ownership as a whole.  I also pioneered efforts using jmeter to engage in performance testing.

positions.title: St Staff QA Engineer
positions.description: Lead Engineer for Security Analytics application.  Built the Security Analytics application automation suite from scratch and led a small team of testers.  This was the first introduction of my entire testing approach, which entails identifying and maintaing a bvt tests to do first level testing, and then a large but always manageable suite of regression tests to use in Sprint work testing.  This product was eventually scheduled for retirement but the customer base became too vocal about how much they loved and used it.   It is still in service today and I do take some credit with my team in establishing and refining its enduring usability.

positions.title: Test Manager
positions.description: Test Manager for Standard Charter Bank Ecommerce.  My time hear was brief but I was able to manage a team that was under contract with no plan for renewal.  After I was able to train them and get them testing using better automation, they were able to stay on and became a vital piece of the overall SLDC.

positions.title: QA Manager
positions.description: Managing the QA team  for the Platform Engineering Group

positions.title: SDE
positions.description:
Real Networks
Collaborated on establishing new procedures for the Shared Services SDLC
Developed the usage of JIRA as an issue tracking system, as well as a system for tracking projects through AGILE principles.  
Employed the JIRA java API's for cross tool integration with JIRA
Greatly streamlined the management of tasks and bugs, collaborating with PGM's, dev leads and QA leads to create a unified process across teams.

positions.title: Lead STE
positions.description: Tested the large scale migration of music data from one database to another.  Led an international team of six people.  Authored several test plans and test suites.

positions.title: SDET
positions.description: As part of the Engineering Services team developed tools and interfaces to tools for the entire Platform/Ecommerce teams.

positions.title: STE
positions.description: Contributed to the success of several key data migrations.  Tested the implementation of Paypal's checkout API.  Tested the development of a new global media platform.

positions.title: SDE
positions.description: Developed a UI for the application that utilized Windows Encoder technology to capture and encode live broadcasts.

positions.title: SDET
positions.description: I was there when it all began.  I helped the first rollout testing of localization in which I became known as finding the bugs the general automation missed.  It was an exciting opportunity for a bold new direction at Microsoft and it was an incredible experience to work on that campus for a contractual postion on such a revoultionary product.

volunteerExperiences.description:
I worked on the volunteer committee and then served on the foundation board which elected which charitable organizations to give money.  
I visited and probed several candidates and made recommendations.
